summary: Ruling for amw8gtiazcaiqib (improvised harness). Capability: yes; 50 ft of syntherope can sling a torch and two steel bottles. But the blade is lit in Aero's right hand: tying a load-bearing harness needs both hands, so Aero must hold the lit hilt clear while knotting with one hand and teeth/elbow, or the work is clumsy. Construction: 3 minutes; Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, no proficiency on the sheet for knots, disadvantage because one hand holds a lit blade (method did not free it). DC 12 for a harness that rides; on a failure the bottles shift and the harness must be retied (still made, but loose: limits). Effectiveness: rides on his back; the bottles are heavy: running or climbing risks slipping (Dex save when he sprints), noisy (bottles knock). World check each minute: nothing approaches in this sandbox.

Tables and rulings for amw8ox67lvzr6v4, fixed before any roll. (A) Wick on Silo Three, 1d6: 1-2 he does not know who sealed it, only that grown-ups say keep off; 3-5 the Warden's men welded it after last harvest, he watched from the fence; 6 as 3-5, and he saw them roll something in on a skid under a tarp first. (B) Wick on the Warden, 1d6: 1-3 he does not know, his ma calls it curfew; 4-6 he heard the Warden say something has been taking stock from the fields and nobody is to be out after dark. (C) Shed contents (unknown to Aero), 1d6: 1-4 the dig crew's tools and sacks only; 5-6 also a farm cat sheltering inside. Nothing threatening either way (sandbox ledger). (D) The lit blade and the chain cut are visible/audible from the Grange (280 ft); 1d6, on 6 a shutter opens and someone looks out, nothing more. (E) Ignite: the hilt is clipped at the left hip for a right-hand draw; igniting it means drawing it right-handed and lighting it in one motion (no extra step, no choice involved). (F) The custom step 'grab the welding torch and gas cans': the cart is empty (evt_0014). The torch and one bottle are already strapped to Aero's back; the other bottle stands beside the shed door. Nothing to take at the cart; incidental, no roll. (G) Reach out through the Force: Aero's sheet gives Force Connection (passive: senses significant Force disturbances, without identity, location or explanation; focused: one VISIBLE creature within 30 ft). Nothing in the shed or near is a significant disturbance, so he senses nothing; no check (failure would not change it). The branch 'I do not sense anything' is then settled by a committed event. (H) Walking: speed reduced 10 ft by the harness; no time pressure, so it only costs time and noise.

Hidden results for amw8ox67lvzr6v4: (C) 6: a farm cat is sheltering in the shed among the dig crew's tools and sacks; it bolted into the back at the clang of the chain. (D) 2: no one at the Grange looks out.
